_note: Session K1b (GDD 4.10 'K1's questions', decision 4): the SEASON REVIEW chapter at the end of October. CareerSystem builds a snapshot of the season on its last night (everything in it is recorded or counted from what the game kept: results, the goals, the season list log, the monthly record, the milestones); the chapter page shows it and ends on the next season. The coach's verdict is a line by his voice and by how the season went (outcome rules below). {he} / {his} are filled with the head coach's pronouns when the snapshot is made.

outcome._note: strong: at least strong_goals of the goals met, or the best time improved by at least one year's typical gain at the age (market.json offers.yearly_gain); tough: no goal met (with goals set) and the best time did not improve by half a year's gain, or no race at all; steady: the rest.

strong.calm: This was a good season. You got faster, and the work was right. Rest well, and we start again from here.
strong.drill: Good season. Results. Now we raise the bar.
strong.warm: I'm so proud of you this season! Look at what you did. Take a proper rest now, you deserve it.
strong.tactician: The season went to plan, and in places better than the plan. Next season we build on exactly this.
strong.analyst: The numbers are clearly up on last year. The curve is steeper than I predicted. We keep the method.
strong.mentor: A fine season. Not every year is like this one; remember what it felt like.
strong.motivator: WHAT A SEASON! You are flying! And it is only the beginning!
strong.speed: Fast season. Faster than last year. More next.

steady.calm: A solid season. Not everything went as hoped, but you moved forward and that is what counts.
steady.drill: Decent. Not enough, but decent. We can do more next season.
steady.warm: It was a good season, even if it wasn't perfect. I saw how hard you worked.
steady.tactician: A season with a few good moves and a few lessons. The lessons are the useful part.
steady.analyst: The result is within what the numbers allowed. Some details to fix; I have the list.
steady.mentor: A season like most seasons: a little forward, a little to learn. That is the way.
steady.motivator: Good work this season! Not everything fell right, but the next one will!
steady.speed: Okay season. Not slow. Not fast enough.

tough.calm: This was a hard season. It happens to every runner. We look at what we can change and go on.
tough.drill: Not good. I know it, you know it. We fix it.
tough.warm: It was a difficult season and I know it wasn't easy. We'll find the way back together.
tough.tactician: The season did not give what we planned. We go through what happened and make a better plan.
tough.analyst: The numbers did not move the way I expected. I want to understand why before the next plan.
tough.mentor: A hard year. I have had them too. They are not wasted if we learn from them.
tough.motivator: A tough one, yes! But we come back stronger, I promise!
